profile.headline: Software Engineer at athenahealth
profile.summary: Experienced Integration Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Engineering - BE focused in Computer Science and Engineering from University of Connecticut.

positions.title: Integration Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and developed customized web applications and automation processes using AIR's suite of insurance risk modeling software for clients, bearing in mind the client's workflow and business requirements.

Collaborated with marketing group to develop and maintain AIR's corporate website, including a complete platform migration.

Provided support to clients on use of AIR's client facing APIs for risk modeling and relay feedback on APIs to the software development group.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed and maintained various Web-based enterprise software applications for clients using ASP.NET, JavaScript and SQL Server. Projects maintained a three-tiered design and utilized browser front ends, RESTful APIs and scheduled batch jobs.
Maintained a suite of applications for handling records for a legal department. Modified existing forms and created new modules to meet functional expectations for the client.
Implemented changes to project management, delivery, and billing suite designed to allow employees to outsource work to external venders. Provided input on the impact of requested changes
Assisted support team in reconciling client issues with a focus of meeting business requirements and providing a clean and consistent user experience.

positions.title: A100 Apprentice
positions.description:
Built a software application in Meteor's full-stack JavaScript platform in an Agile team, completing and deploying a working software application for a local startup venture, Vidzaar.
Development work (which spanned the software development lifecycle) as supplemented by targeted training in Agile process, fullstack programming, UI/UX, technical communication, and DevOps.
